# Annual review minutes

## Attendance
Present: Ottoline (coordinator), Brannoc (rota and deliveries), Muffet
(treasurer), Corvane (equipment), Wexley (secretary). Apologies from Tamsin,
who joins in September as apprentice and was invited as an observer.

## Coordinator's report
Ottoline reported a steady year. Weekly bread output rose from roughly 900 to
1,150 loaves, mostly from the second wholesale round. The Saturday stall
remains the largest single source of income. Volunteer hours held steady at
about 140 per week, though early shifts are still hard to fill. She thanked the
garden club for the fruit surplus that carried the seasonal specials through
the autumn.

## Treasurer's report
Muffet presented the accounts. Income was up, but so were costs: flour rose
twice, butter once, and the energy bill for the deck ovens remains the largest
overhead. The reserve is now just under three months of running costs. Muffet
recommended building it to four months before any new spending. The accounts
were accepted unanimously.

## Equipment
Corvane reported that deck oven two still runs hot and the thermostat is near
the end of its life. A quote for replacement has been requested. Mixer one
needed a new gearbox seal in the spring. The proofer humidity sensor was
replaced under warranty. Corvane asked that the equipment log be filled in more
consistently; several faults were only found because someone mentioned them in
passing.

## Rota and deliveries
Brannoc noted that the swap system on the whiteboard works when people use it.
Two missed deliveries this year both traced back to unconfirmed swaps. The
board agreed to keep the Monday confirmation and add a reminder to the
handover note. The van passed its service; the tyres will need replacing
before winter.

## Allergen incident
The March incident was discussed in full. The board agreed the revised
allergen policy should go to the membership with the second-person check
included. No further incidents have been reported since the change was trialled
informally. Thanks were recorded to Muffet for catching it at the stall.

## Membership
Membership stands at 41, up from 36. Two members left after moving away. The
board discussed whether to cap membership given the kitchen size and agreed to
revisit the question at the spring meeting rather than decide now.

## Elections
Ottoline was re-elected coordinator unopposed. Muffet agreed to serve one more
year as treasurer but asked for a successor to shadow her. Wexley continues as
secretary. Corvane and Brannoc continue in their roles.

## Any other business
Wexley raised the shared calendar: events are still added too late. The board
asked all groups to respect the ten-day rule. The meeting closed at 21:40.
